[00:00:30.020] What are carbon fibers? Basically, they are fibers which are made mostly of carbon atoms, and the diameter is just about 5 to 10 micrometers.
[00:00:42.992] When you compare this diameter with the human hair, as you can see in the picture here, the human hair is much much thicker as compared to the carbon fiber.
[00:00:55.044] So they are very very thin fibers and several thousands of these fibers are twisted together to make a yarn and from that yarn the fabric is woven.
